english.title: Knowingly serve as a juror at an inquest when disqualified
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) served as a juror at a inquest into **(..SPECIFY THE REASON FOR THE HOLDING OF THE INQUEST..), when disqualified from jury service, knowing that you were so disqualified
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 1 of Schedule 6 to the Coroners and Justice Act 2009.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five of the standard scale.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
